@a11y-skills/audit — Fixture Gallery

This gallery lists all HTML fixture pages used by the fixture-gallery integration tests. Each fixture is crafted to trigger (or pass) a specific WCAG rule. Open a fixture in a browser to inspect it visually.

Warning: Fixtures marked "finding" intentionally contain accessibility problems for testing purposes. They are linked (not iframed) to avoid polluting your browser's assistive technology context.
